identity_policy: Each record uses a randomly generated opaque identifier of the form annotator-<hex>; do not include names, e-mail addresses, affiliations, free-form notes, or source-document metadata in a public record.
independence_requirement: Before seeing the lexical-screen labels or another annotator's record, each annotator independently labels every packet item and attests to that fact in the identity-free record. The public gate verifies distinct opaque identifiers and the attestations; the research team must retain any nonpublic process documentation needed to substantiate independence.

labels.credential_reuse: The description itself explicitly connects the lateral or remote-access action to a credential, account, token, cookie, or authentication material already obtained or compromised.
labels.independent_mechanism: The description itself attributes the action to an independent mechanism such as brute force, password spraying, tunnelling, or tool transfer rather than reuse of previously obtained credentials.
labels.insufficient_evidence: The description does not itself establish either relationship. Campaign-level co-occurrence with credential access is insufficient.
